entries.subject: Bulge
entries.finding: Salo et al. (2015), S4G Pipeline 4, table 7, NGC4501, model _bd: a Sérsic bulge (5.9% of the light, magnitude 11.807, half-light radius 5.24″ = 0.49 kpc, n = 2.081, axis ratio 0.674, PA 136.87°) and an exponential disc (94.1% of the light, scale length 39.66″ = 3.74 kpc, axis ratio 0.506, PA 142.56°, face-on central surface brightness 18.781, 18.041 as projected on the sky). Used as published; the half-light surface brightness the bake needs, 18.027 mag per square arcsecond, follows from the bulge's magnitude, radius, index and axis ratio. At the disc's 62.95° the bulge's axis ratio is one an oblate spheroid in the disc plane can show (intrinsic 0.56).
